title: Cartwise+ Membership Earlier Pauses Within the Year
content:
Earlier pauses share the Cartwise+ Membership pause allowance over the year, and how they are counted is set by their booked length.

**Rule.**

1. When the pauses logged in the last twelve months (by first paused day) total at least 30 days, the allowance is reduced by their whole booked length in days.
2. When they total fewer than 30 days but at least one day, each of those pauses is counted as a flat number of days equal to the plan's shortest pause, whatever its booked length, and the allowance is reduced by the number of those pauses multiplied by the plan's shortest pause. The shortest pause is 14 days on each plan that offers a pause (Cartwise+ Assist Monthly, Cartwise+ Student Monthly and Cartwise+ Monthly).
3. With no pause logged in that time, the allowance is not reduced.

## Evidence

The membership's pause history: each entry records the first paused day and the booked length in calendar days. An entry counts when its first paused day falls in the last twelve months, counted in whole months ending today; an entry whose first paused day is on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical, shortest pause 14 days)

| Pauses in the window and their booked lengths | Total booked | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| one of 45 days | 45 | 45 days |
| one of 20 and one of 10 | 30 | 30 days |
| one of 20 and one of 9 | 29 | two pauses counted at 14 each, 28 days |
| one of 7 | 7 | one pause counted at 14, 14 days |
| none | 0 | no reduction |
